newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says caution needed on import price rises.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says caution needed on import price rises.

text.p: Any further increases in import prices should be viewed with caution, as they are more likely to affect domestic prices now than they have been in the past, a Bank of Japan (BOJ) official told reporters on Friday.

The official said that the price differential for final goods between Japan and other countries has almost disappeared and therefore additional rises in import prices will more easily be reflected in domestic prices.

The official added, however, that due to softer crude oil prices and the fact that the improvement in domestic supply and demand conditions has been moderate, it is likely that domestic wholesale prices will move in a stable manner in the future.
He said that the central bank needed to monitor movements in supply and demand conditions, as well as foreign exchange rates, more closely.
